subject: SEO Update — ARLO — 2026-08-24
html:
PageWhat ChangedTarget KeywordCheck It
All 15 /destinations/[slug] pages (fix)The shared page template hardcoded og:title/og:description/twitter:title/twitter:description to a generic, wrong string ("ARLO for SEO Specialists...") on every single destination page, so sharing e.g. /destinations/looker_studio on Slack or social showed the wrong title. Same bug in the page's WebPage schema: name/url/description were all hardcoded to the homepage instead of the actual page. Fixed both to use each page's own title/description/canonical URL, and expanded the breadcrumb schema from 2 levels (Home/ARLO) to 3 (Home/Destinations/the actual page).accuracy/schema fix, not keyword-targetedaskarlo.app/destinations/looker_studio
All 15 /destinations/[slug] pages (new)None of the 15 pages had FAQPage structured data despite each one rendering a live FAQ block — added it, generated directly from the same FAQ content shown on the page so the two can never drift out of sync.FAQPage schema — AI-Overview / rich-result eligibilityaskarlo.app/destinations/power_bi

Why this instead of another blog post: the last 5 sessions in a row shipped blog content because the connector matrix and comparison hub were both fully caught up. catalog.ts is still unchanged this session (mailchimp's Aug 2026 ETA is now current-month and still unshipped), so re-read the original SXO audit for other human-independent work instead of a 6th straight post, and found this — a real correctness bug on 15 already-indexed pages, not just a content gap.

Needs your attention (unchanged): mailchimp's own catalog.ts ETA is "August 2026" — about a week left in the month and still coming_soon. If it ships, that's the first new connector-matrix page available in 5+ months. Off-page link building is still 0 of 6 directories/registries (needs a human with a browser — this sandbox has no outbound HTTP). GSC submission and the dormant 6-persona route.ts scaffold decision are both still open from prior sessions.

Next: the SXO audit's own recommendation to reframe 2-3 destination pages (Looker Studio, Power BI, BigQuery) with explicit comparison-table content against Looker Studio/Power BI/BigQuery natively is still open — scoped as a content/design task separate from this session's schema fix. Full detail in docs/seo-strategy/worklog.txt (top entry).
